northStar: The Practice Cloth — a child's embroidered sampler, careful and even at the top, loose and confident by the foot, signed by the child who made it. Learning you can see.

stitch.note: One setting drives every rule, frame, divider and underline on the site. Changing it in :root changes all of them together.
stitch.ruleSnippet: background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--thread) 0 9px, transparent 9px 16px); background-size: 100% 1.5px; background-repeat: no-repeat;
stitch.frameSnippet: .stitched draws four running-stitch edges with four repeating-linear-gradients positioned to the four sides. Must be paired with background-color, never the background shorthand.

elevation.philosophy: Flat. A sampler has no drop shadows — it has stitching, and cloth basted in layers.
elevation.rule: These three are the only shadows on the site. Do not add a fourth.

motion.authoredMoment: A section's running-stitch rule draws itself across (scaleX from left) and its motifs land in sequence, like a row being worked. One moment, used once per section.
motion.gate: .js class set by an inline script before first paint. Every hidden state is scoped under it, so with no JavaScript all content renders visible and in place.
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all reveal transforms and opacity with !important.

notes.900: splits and hero grid collapse to one column
notes.1080: desktop nav swaps for the menu panel
notes.640: motif bands drop past the 7th mark

typographyRoles.Lora: Every heading, editorial statement and emotional line. Italic reserved for pull quotes, the footer signature, and program band notes.
typographyRoles.Poppins: Body, navigation, buttons, labels, forms, ages, hours, ratios, all practical information.
typographyRoles.rule: Two families only. No third face, ever.

rules: Gold Tan #DDCAB6 is 1.2:1 on Warm Cream — it may fill, but it may never draw a line or carry text on a light ground. Use tan-ink #A78F72 to draw.
No text eyebrow above a heading. A motif opens the section; the heading carries itself.
Anything carrying .stitched must use background-color, not the background shorthand.
One drawn alphabet. No emoji, no icon library.
The nest motif is used sparingly — four places across the whole site.
--ink-faint is the floor for small text, not a lighter grey.
Card grids are never a page's structure; use a worked list.
Sections nest no more than two containers deep, so the design is rebuildable in Elementor.
antiReferences: The pastel-blob card grid the early-learning category ships by default.
Austere cream editorial minimalism — the predictable opposite.
Gradients, glassmorphism, floating card stacks, rounded-rectangle everything.
The Hero → Cards → Cards → CTA skeleton.
